name: Example Fish
author: JAMM
description: Two example custom fish: Goldie (shallow small fish) and Glowfin (nocturnal pulsing medium fish).

fish.name: Goldie
fish.description: A cheerful golden fish that swims lazily near the dock.
fish.caughtDescription: You caught Goldie! Its bright scales shimmer in the sunlight.

fish.name: Glowfin
fish.description: A nocturnal reef swimmer whose fins pulse with cyan light after dusk.
fish.caughtDescription: Glowfin pulses with bioluminescence and darts away when startled by a fast lure.
